pickup_or_partial_bars.print_claim: One flagged eighth in upper staff and one eighth rest in lower staff: 1/2 quarter.
Second ending: two sixteenths then a quarter chord above; eighth then quarter below: 3/2 quarters.
One flagged eighth above and eighth rest below: 1/2 quarter.

addressing.bars: P001-P182 in physical reading order, including pickups and full-bar fermata rests; no repeat expansion
addressing.staff: Global 1 upper / 2 lower; one piano part P1
addressing.onset: Nonnegative rational quarter units from each physical region start
addressing.barlines: Page raster coordinates; system-opening boundary includes signatures
addressing.voice_frame: Both staves have the region capacity. Independent voices may be shorter; no inserted silence is asserted.
